baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ ... لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Forward speed, elevated orientation, and a gaze that cannot return form a one-way sensorimotor circuit: the body is driven onward while visual feedback to the self is cut.

activation_trace.role: The image of speeding while facing forward supplies the circuit's compelled forward drive.
Elevation without downward correction fixes the head at the circuit's forward-facing pole.
The literal head and uppermost part localize the elevated bodily axis.
Return to a prior place is explicitly negated, supplying the missing feedback path.
The eye, gaze, and blink identify what fails to cycle back.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists frightened people rushing with raised heads and fixed eyes.
changed_reading.after: The postures interlock as a one-way bodily system: locomotion continues, but perception cannot return to regulate or reorient the mover.

baseline_models.mechanism: The heart-word can carry an image of inward heat, but its predicate makes that center air or vacancy; terror is rendered as material evacuation rather than merely an emotion.

activation_trace.role: The heart imagined through inner kindling supplies the normally active and heated center.
Air and vacancy replace that center's content, turning inward heat into an evacuated cavity.

changed_reading.before: Their hearts are empty from fear.
changed_reading.after: The organ figured as inward heat has been materially evacuated, leaving an outer body in motion around an absent center.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ق ن ع inventory lets request, abasement, facing, and head-raising coexist, so the lifted head can be carried as an exposed petitioning posture rather than confidence or pride.

activation_trace.role: Abasement and submission make the body's forward posture involuntary rather than assured.
Abased asking supplies a petitionary potential within the same root as the raised-head posture.
Facing a destination gives the petition a directed bodily orientation.
The literal raised head keeps the exploratory request reading anchored in the focus construction.

changed_reading.before: Their heads are raised as one symptom of panic.
changed_reading.after: Their elevation may also stage a mute, abased appeal: they face upward or forward as petitioners whose posture remains but whose agency is gone.

baseline_models.mechanism: The head's branch into leadership collides with abasement: what can signify precedence is lifted only as exposed anatomy, while the empty heart removes an interior seat of resolve.

activation_trace.role: Headship and precedence supply the status-value that the scene bodily inverts.
Humiliation and submission reverse the head's possible sign of command.
Physical elevation preserves the outward form of high position after its authority has vanished.
The vacant interior removes the inward substance that might support the elevated exterior.

changed_reading.before: Raised heads are only a visual detail.
changed_reading.after: The scene can invert headship itself: the outward sign of elevation remains, but it has been reduced to helpless anatomy and emptied of command.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier actors perform or demand return; at the focus, the elementary return of their own gaze is negated. A chosen politics of rejection and forced return is reversed into loss of bodily return.

activation_trace.role: A controlled return of the hands toward the mouths supplies an earlier agentive inward return.
The demand that messengers return after departure supplies coerced return as a social action.
The same return image is now negated inside the person's own visual apparatus.
The gaze is the bodily possession that no longer comes back to its bearer.

structural_cues: The surah moves from enacted return at 14:9 and demanded return at 14:13 to negated return at 14:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated return roots and an agency shift; I infer a retributive reversal from outwardly imposed return to inward incapacity. A live alternative is that the recurrence only intensifies physical panic without moral reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Their stare simply does not come back down.
changed_reading.after: Their failed gaze-return embodies an agency reversal: those who rejected and tried to force return can no longer recover even their own look.

context_deltas.mechanism: The leaders and followers emerge exposed together, and followers discover that elevated social rank cannot protect. The focus converts the head's status-value into a uniformly raised, abased body part.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into exposure removes the shelter behind which rank operated.
Gathering the formerly separated parties supplies the field in which ranks collapse together.
Elevated honor and headship identify the social height that proves ineffective.
Following behind supplies the hierarchy's lower position and its failed dependence.
The head's leadership image is carried into the bodily scene for inversion.
Abasement makes the raised heads a shared subjection rather than retained rank.

structural_cues: At 14:21 the weak and arrogant appear together, and the exchange ends with no escape; 14:43 gives the collective levelling a bodily posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposed gathering, leader-follower hierarchy, and abased raised heads; I map social headship onto anatomical heads. The alternative is to keep رُءُوسِهِمْ wholly literal and treat 14:21 only as thematic background.

changed_reading.before: The raised head is an individual fear posture.
changed_reading.after: It also pictures social levelling: headship persists only as a raised body part shared by rulers and followers under the same abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tree sequence distinguishes high extension supported by a fixed root from elevation without settlement. In the focus, heads remain high while hearts are vacant, producing a human figure whose upper extension has lost inward rootedness.

activation_trace.role: A base or root supplies the hidden support required for sound vertical extension.
Durable fixation makes the good tree's height stable rather than merely elevated.
The high branch supplies an upper extension that remains connected to an origin.
Whole-root extraction supplies the counterimage of an elevated form severed from support.
Negated stability names what the uprooted figure lacks.
Stability of heart, intellect, and speech links rootedness to an interior faculty.
The raised head supplies height without proving support.
The empty heart supplies the missing interior base beneath the elevated exterior.

structural_cues: 14:24-27 repeatedly contrasts fixed origin, high branch, uprooting, lack of settlement, and inner stabilization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a vertical tree mechanism and a later high-head/empty-heart body; I infer an embodied tree analogy in which the heart functions as hidden root. The alternative is a looser contrast between stability and panic with no body-tree mapping.

changed_reading.before: Raised heads indicate where the condemned are looking.
changed_reading.after: Their height is counterfeit verticality: an upper form remains extended, but the vacant interior leaves it functionally uprooted and without settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 14:37 hearts and ه و ي form an attractive motion toward people and sanctuary; at 14:43 the same heart-root is predicated by the air/vacancy branch of ه و ي. Directed inward desire is converted into directionless interior absence.

activation_trace.role: Hearts as inwardly kindled centers are the moving subjects of the earlier attraction.
Inclination and desire give those hearts a directed pull toward a relational center.
The same inward heart-center remains grammatically present in the focus.
Air and vacancy replace the earlier branch of directed inclination.

structural_cues: The pair ف ء د + ه و ي recurs only six ayahs apart, first as heart-motion toward others and then as a nominal empty state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root pair and the branch shift from inclination to vacancy; I infer a reversal from relational attraction to evacuated direction. The alternative is ordinary polysemy with no deliberate echo.

changed_reading.before: The hearts in 14:43 are simply empty.
changed_reading.after: They are the reversal of the inclining hearts of 14:37: a faculty once able to move toward a center now retains only air where direction and attachment had been.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah raises and fixes the eyes; the focus then resolves that arrest into sustained forward staring whose gaze cannot return. The two ayahs form successive stages of one perceptual seizure.

activation_trace.role: The explicit image of eyes staring or standing out supplies the first stage of ocular arrest.
Literal eyesight identifies the sensory faculty seized in the preceding clause.
Sustained open-eyed looking carries the preceding stare into the focus.
Negated return specifies the arrest as loss of visual recovery.
The eye, gaze, and blink make that failed recovery physically precise.

structural_cues: 14:42 ends with eyes staring; 14:43 begins without a scene break and details head angle, sustained gaze, and non-return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and complementary eye branches; I infer a temporal sequence from protruding fixation to failed visual return. The live alternative is appositional restatement rather than successive stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus independently depicts a frozen stare.
changed_reading.after: It is the second stage of the arrest announced in 14:42: the eyes first become fixed, then lose the return movement by which sight normally recovers its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah voices a plea to be delayed and a promise to answer the call. Read backward, the raised-head ق ن ع posture becomes an appeal whose answer-channel is already closed by irreversible judgment.

activation_trace.role: Abased asking supplies the petitionary potential of the raised-head posture.
Literal head elevation keeps the request reading attached to the visible body.
Answering speech supplies the response they belatedly promise to give.
The verbal call supplies the reciprocal summons to which the speakers now claim they would turn.

structural_cues: The silent posture of 14:43 is followed immediately by direct petition in 14:44, but the requested postponement is framed as too late.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request-capable focus root followed by plea, call, and answer language; I infer that the posture anticipates failed petition. The alternative is that ق ن ع contributes only head angle and the speech begins a separate scene.

changed_reading.before: The condemned merely hold their heads up while rushing.
changed_reading.after: Their raised heads can be heard as a petition frozen before speech: the posture of asking survives at the moment when reciprocal answer and delay are no longer available.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, not an equation of heart with ash: 14:18 supplies ash stripped of controllability by wind, while 14:43 anchors the proposal in the heart explicitly made air. Render only as an 'as if' account of inward dispossession.

activation_trace.role: Burnt ash supplies matter whose prior substance has been reduced to dispersible residue.
Wind and moving air supply the medium that strips the ash from its owners' control.
Negated effective capability marks the inability to recover what has been dispersed.
The inwardly heated heart supplies the bodily site of the proposed material reversal.
Air and vacancy anchor the analogy inside the focus rather than leaving it as an independent ash theme.

changed_reading.before: The heart is vacant because of terror.
changed_reading.after: The earlier ash-in-wind image may recur inside the person: the inward center is as dispossessed of substance and recoverability as deeds scattered into air.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The feedback-loop language is a reader-supplied systems analogy and should not be presented as lexical meaning. It remains anchored in the focus's speed, gaze, and negated return, while 14:32-33 supplies contrasting flow and persistent ordered motion.

activation_trace.role: Continuous flowing motion supplies an ordered trajectory that reaches and serves its course.
Persistent regular striving supplies the surrounding model of sustained motion.
Forward speed preserves motion in the condemned body.
Negated return makes that bodily motion unlike the surrounding coordinated systems.
The gaze supplies the missing feedback signal in the analogy.

changed_reading.before: They rush while unable to lower or recover their gaze.
changed_reading.after: Against a surah of flowing and persistent ordered motion, they become a broken subsystem: propulsion remains, but perceptual return no longer closes the loop.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation deliberately uses the sale-rescission branch of ر د د at formal distance from a verb whose immediate subject is gaze. It is still anchored in لَا يَرْتَدُّ and sharpened by the explicit no-sale/no-intimacy day at 14:31; render as legal-economic resonance, never as the clause's direct translation.

activation_trace.role: Exchange by sale supplies the transaction explicitly unavailable on that day.
Intimacy permeating the self supplies the social recourse that is unavailable alongside exchange.
Rescission and recovery in sale lend the negated return a contained nonrecourse resonance.
The gaze remains the literal item that cannot return, preventing the legal analogy from replacing the syntax.

changed_reading.before: Their gaze does not return to them.
changed_reading.after: At the day without exchange or intimate recourse, even the self's gaze is nonreturnable: bodily perception enacts the closure of recovery while remaining the literal subject.

strongest_changes: The repeated ف ء د + ه و ي pair turns the inclining hearts of 14:37 into the air-filled hearts of 14:43.
The adjacency of 14:42-43 resolves staring eyes into a one-way gaze that cannot recover.
Earlier agentive and coerced returns are reversed when the condemned lose the return of their own sight.
The fixed-root/uprooted-tree sequence makes raised heads over vacant hearts read as verticality without support.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed exact lexical reversals and functional sequences that a local fear-posture reading misses: attraction becomes vacancy, imposed return becomes failed self-return, social height becomes anatomy, and stable vertical growth becomes unsupported elevation.
remaining_uncertainties: The headship reading depends on carrying ر ء س from anatomy into status.
The petition reading depends on activating the asking branch of ق ن ع beside the construction's clearer raised-head sense.
The ash, systems, and nonrecourse readings are deliberately contained cross-domain analogies rather than direct glosses.
